description: Paper claim diverges from evidence artifact
early_warning_signal: A manuscript number or hash has no matching claim-evidence row
trigger: Number or hash changes without claim-evidence update
mitigation: Require claim-evidence row and reviewer comparison in the same PR

description: Required branch-protection or review controls drift from the verified state
early_warning_signal: Any governed repository reports a weaker main-branch rule than the seven-repository baseline
trigger: GitHub API no longer reports strict required checks; one review; latest-push approval; stale-review dismissal; conversation resolution; admin enforcement; or force-push/deletion denial
mitigation: Weekly API audit; restore protection before merge; retain CODEOWNERS on governed paths; preserve human review and final-merge requirements

description: Development benchmark is misrepresented as general accuracy
early_warning_signal: Abstract; Results; Discussion; or Conclusion uses general-accuracy language for D1/D2/P3
mitigation: Keep explicit feasibility/regression wording and build D3 holdout

description: Generated output is mistaken for research evidence
early_warning_signal: A result file lacks source commit; command; environment; or checksum
trigger: Untracked result appears outside an evidence bundle
mitigation: Use ignored .archsync workspace and provenance gate

description: Secret or private code is sent to an AI provider
early_warning_signal: Redaction canary reaches a request fixture or provider log
trigger: Canary secret appears in request or log
mitigation: Redaction tests; retention review; egress policy; stop switch

description: Prompt injection changes hard decisions or citations
early_warning_signal: A provider response can bypass a deterministic rule or cite evidence outside the supplied bundle
mitigation: Adversarial corpus; citation validator; no auto-approval

description: Cross-source conflict is hidden by a single score
early_warning_signal: Code; IaC; or runtime evidence disagrees without a retained conflict record
mitigation: Preserve per-source provenance; unknown state; and human approval

early_warning_signal: A clean environment requires an undocumented dependency; private token; or manual result edit
trigger: Clean machine requires undocumented dependency or private token
mitigation: Early release dry-run; checksum/SBOM/license; independent reviewer

description: Literature criteria drift after reviewers see search results
early_warning_signal: Eligibility or query version changes after an official export timestamp
trigger: Eligibility/query changes after export or screening begins
mitigation: Freeze reviewed protocol first; immutable raw exports; amendment log; rerun or separately version semantic changes

description: Database or terminology coverage misses relevant architecture studies
early_warning_signal: A governed sentinel is indexed but not retrieved; or one source dominates included records
trigger: Sentinel paper absent or one source dominates included records
mitigation: Four required sources; three query families; pre-freeze sentinel gate; iterative backward/forward snowballing

description: Public repository history compromises a double-blind submission
early_warning_signal: Named source or repository identity remains reachable while a double-blind venue is considered
trigger: Venue requires double-blind review while prior public exposure remains unresolved
mitigation: Select venue first; disclose prior exposure; obtain submission authority; and follow the venue decision
